xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4281: Orca-style onboarding: Add Project dialog with repo-root snap, folder-of-repos import (separate or one multi-repo project), and a Smart field on New Workspace

plan.title: Orca-style onboarding: Add Project dialog with repo-root snap, folder-of-repos import (separate or one multi-repo project), and a Smart field on New Workspace
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: The operator already split the onboarding program into three sibling issues (PAN-4280/4281/4282) and assigned W6-W9 here. W6-W8 share the project create core, the one AddProjectDialog, and post-create navigation in App.tsx; W9's Smart field shares NewWorkspacePage.tsx with the dialog's chip wiring. The surface is wide mainly because of tests and four doc files; each of the 18 items is a small vertical slice.

narratives.Problem: Adding a project is a full page (/projects/new) that refuses a subfolder of a repo (repository-root-elsewhere), registers a folder of repos as one plain project, suggests nothing, submits clone only on Ctrl/Cmd+Enter, explains nothing for a non-git folder, and leaves the Launcher unfocused afterwards. New Workspace has a plain title input and says 'Multiple projects are registered' when there are none. The operator wants Orca-grade onboarding, and a folder of repos must be addable as separate projects or as one multi-repo (polyrepo) project.
narratives.Proposal: Extend the create core (snap to repo root as a notice, depth-1 nested scan, multi-repo registration via a repos input, read-only suggestions route), extract the page form into ProjectCreateForm, and build one AddProjectDialog (modal via a zustand store, page at /projects/new) with start/clone/create/folder/nested steps that register only through POST /api/projects/resolve then POST /api/projects. Focus the Launcher after a create. On New Workspace add project-missing and branchCandidates to workspace resolve and a Smart field that classifies issue refs, branches and names. Full detail: .pan/drafts/pan-4281.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to Home, the Launcher's intents, the No-project deck or terminals (PAN-4280)
- No first-run checklist, prerequisites, pan install or pan doctor changes (PAN-4282)
- No Orca onboarding wizard (agent/theme/notifications)
- No editing of an existing project's repos from the dialog; no grouping beyond the single multi-repo choice
- No git init offer for a non-git folder
- No new spawn path: the Smart field never starts an agent; issue refs route to /issues/<ID>
- No GitLab/Jira/Linear URL lookup in the Smart field
- No second project-registration route
- No change to pan workspace new --dry-run output

autoDecisions.summary: 'Add this folder as one project' registers one multi-repo (workspace.type: polyrepo) project over the checked child repos, keeping W7's label with a sub-line.
autoDecisions.rationale: Operator decision (3) in the issue body says a folder of repos can be one multi-repo project; W7's button label predates it, so the label stays and its meaning follows the decision.

autoDecisions.summary: Multi-repo registration writes workspace {type: polyrepo, workspaces_dir: workspaces, repos[{name,path,branch_prefix: feature/, default_branch?, forge?}]} plus pan_records.repo = first repo, and no tracker.
autoDecisions.rationale: That is the shape of the live mind-your-now and auricle entries; pan_records keeps .pan/ inside a git checkout when the root is a plain folder (resolveInfraRepo defaults to the root); one tracker cannot be inferred from N remotes.

autoDecisions.summary: Nested-batch and suggestion adds use a new resolveThenCreateProject helper instead of the stateful useProjectCreateIntent hook.
autoDecisions.rationale: The hook drives one debounced form and has no repos field; FR-17/AC-7 constrain routes (resolve then create), which the helper honors.

autoDecisions.summary: A nested batch calls onCreated once with the last success; failures keep the dialog open with per-row errors and a Done button.
autoDecisions.rationale: Per-row onCreated would navigate repeatedly mid-batch; a failure must stay visible.

autoDecisions.summary: returnTo in modal mode travels through the dialog store (takeAddProjectReturnTo) into getProjectCreatedNavigation's new optional parameter.
autoDecisions.rationale: getProjectCreatedNavigation reads window.location.search, which is /workspaces/new in modal mode; App.tsx is at its 1019-line ceiling so logic lives in the store module.

autoDecisions.summary: The Smart field's 'Use as the name' sets a slug (toWorkspaceSlug), and the Branch preview shows the core's intent.branchName (scratch/<name>).
autoDecisions.rationale: validateFeatureName rejects spaces; the issue's implementation checkpoint says to reuse the core's branch derivation, which exists at workspaces/create.ts:339.

autoDecisions.summary: The NewProjectPage chosen-mode body moves unchanged into ProjectCreateForm; the two page tests change only entry-label regexes.
autoDecisions.rationale: Moving rather than rewriting preserves every no-loss row; the issue's final copy renames the entry actions, so label regexes must follow.

autoDecisions.summary: pan project add prints resolve notices; the --dry-run JSON carries notices, nestedRepositories and workspaceRepos automatically.
autoDecisions.rationale: The snap changes CLI behavior silently otherwise; the CLI and dashboard share the core.

autoDecisions.summary: GET /api/projects/suggestions returns {root, repositories} and lives in project-create-routes.ts with a no-loss-matrix READ row.
autoDecisions.rationale: The folder step needs getDefaultCwd() as its picker start; projects.ts is at 955 lines; every new route needs a matrix row or CI fails.

autoDecisions.summary: Issue prefixes for the Smart field come from /api/registered-projects rows' linearTeam (getIssuePrefix).
autoDecisions.rationale: The route already returns the prefix under that field; no new route is needed.

autoDecisions.summary: New frontend test files are appended to root package.json test:frontend-subset.
autoDecisions.rationale: CI runs only that frontend list (codebase map conventions.md); unlisted tests would never gate a PR.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep W9 in this issue and set plan.metadata.sizeJustification instead of filing another sibling.
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator already split the program into three issues and assigned W6-W9 here; auto mode should not shrink assigned scope.
